chunks: "The wisal that has been prohibited is that a man makes his evening meal his pre-dawn meal."

key_terms.اَلْوِصَالُ: continuous fasting without properly breaking the fast
key_terms.سَحُورَهُ: his pre-dawn meal before the next day's fast
key_terms.عَشَاءَهُ: his evening meal with which he would break the fast

ai.seo_question: What is the prohibited form of wisal fasting according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith defines the prohibited form of continuous fasting (wisal) as delaying one’s evening meal until it effectively becomes the pre-dawn meal. It clarifies a fasting ruling by specifying the practical meaning of the forbidden act.
